image_description: A side-profile view of a bison standing on a paved surface. The image captures the head, massive shoulder hump, and forequarters in detail. The fur is thick and shaggy, particularly around the head and shoulders, with a lighter, possibly snow-dusted or frosted appearance on the top of the head. The hindquarters are visible but less detailed. One front leg is clearly visible, while the other legs are partially obscured or out of frame. The background consists of blurred trees and foliage.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is large and broad relative to the body. Short, curved horns are clearly visible protruding from the top of the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct beard of long, dark hair hangs from the chin and throat area, consistent with bison anatomy.
The eye is visible and appears dark, though partially shadowed by fur.
Ears are not prominently visible, appearing small and nestled within the thick fur of the head, which matches the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The body exhibits a massive build with a pronounced height at the shoulders (withers), creating the characteristic bison silhouette.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The forequarters are covered in thick, shaggy dark brown fur, and the shoulder hump is very prominent and well-defined.
The fur on the visible portion of the hindquarters appears shorter and less dense compared to the heavy shagginess of the forequarters.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horns are relatively short and curved, appearing proportionate to the large mass of the head and body.
While one front leg is visible and appears sturdy, the feet/hooves are cut off by the bottom edge of the frame or obscured by the ground angle, making 'cloven hooves' untestable.
The rear of the bison is either out of frame or obscured by the angle, so the tail is not visible for verification.

artifact_observations.location: Top of the head and upper neck
artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a patch of white/grey material on the top of the head that resembles snow or frost. While possible in nature, the texture looks slightly painted-on or inconsistent with the surrounding fur directionality, suggesting a minor generation artifact or style transfer issue.

The background is significantly blurred, likely due to depth-of-field simulation. This is common in photography but can sometimes indicate AI smoothing. It is minor and does not affect the subject integrity.
